name: ABC-Bench
description: A suite of evaluations measuring agentic biosecurity-relevant capabilities of LLM-based agents, including tasks such as operating liquid handling robots, designing DNA fragments, and evading DNA synthesis screening.
reputation: A very recent, niche benchmark from the biosecurity/agentic-LLM literature with little evidence of broad community adoption yet.
notes: Evaluates complex end-to-end biosecurity tasks requiring biology and software expertise; includes real lab validation of generated code.
